titulo_es: The environment: we should, we should, it is important

riciclare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

inquinare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

dovremmo.consejo: First plural person on dovere's parole.

salvare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: **Bisogna riciclare di più** (More to be recycled); **Dovremmo usare i mezzi pubblici** (We should use public transport); **È fondamentale risparmiare energia** (It is essential to save energy).

filas: Dovremmo usare regolarmente i mezzi pubblici.
È importante non inquinare i mari con la plastica.

frases.it: Guarda quanta plastica c'è in questo parco: è un vero peccato!
frases.es: ¡Mira cuánto plástico hay en este parque: es una verdadera pena!
frases.en: Look how much plastic there is in this park: it's a real shame!

frases.it: Hai ragione, bisogna riciclare di più per tutelare l'ambiente cittadino.
frases.es: Tienes razón, hay que reciclar más para proteger el entorno urbano.
frases.en: You're right, you need to recycle more to protect the urban environment.

frases.it: E per ridurre l'inquinamento dell'aria, dovremmo usare i mezzi pubblici.
frases.es: Y para reducir la contaminación del aire, deberíamos usar el transporte público.
frases.en: And to reduce air pollution, we should use public transport.

frases.it: Esatto: ognuno di noi deve fare la propria parte per salvare il pianeta!
frases.es: Exacto: ¡cada uno de nosotros debe poner de su parte para salvar el planeta!
frases.en: Exactly: each of us must put on their side to save the planet!

bloques.pregunta: What does Matteo propose in the face of the abandonment of plastic waste?

opciones.texto: Fomentar el reciclaje sistemático para salvaguardar el medio ambiente urbano.
opciones.explicacion: «Bisogna riciclare di più per tutelare l'ambiente».

opciones.texto: Burn the plastics into open-air bonfires inside the park.
opciones.explicacion: Harmful practice and contrary to any ecological pattern.

opciones.texto: To prohibit pedestrian access to all citizens without exception.
opciones.explicacion: Restrictive measures outside the educational spirit of dialogue.

bloques.frase: Per contrastare il riscaldamento globale, è fondamentale ___ energia nelle nostre case.

opciones.explicacion: Infinitive dependent on predictive adjective: «è fondamentale risparmiare».
It means «despilfarrar», the opposite of sustainability.
It means «destruir», absurd in the ecological recommendation.

bloques.frase: Dovremmo usare più spesso i mezzi pubblici per ridurre le emissioni.

opciones.texto: It would be appropriate to use collective transport more often to limit pollution.
opciones.explicacion: Use of the «dovremmo» prudential recommendation conditional.

opciones.texto: It is mandatory to buy a private, large-cylinder vehicle.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the promotion of collective means of transport.

opciones.texto: All metro and bus lines are cancelled by indefinite strike.
opciones.explicacion: Introduce a non-existent labour incidence into the message.

bloques.pregunta: What negative awareness-raising imperative does the «Non inquinare il pianeta!» slogan make?

opciones.explicacion: Negative second person singular with infinitive.

opciones.texto: We pollute the planet every day!
opciones.explicacion: Present assertion that it does not exercise moral warning function.

opciones.texto: The planet is completely safe from danger!
opciones.explicacion: A naive statement that contradicts the call for attention.

bloques.frase: Bisogna riciclare di più per salvare il pianeta
bloques.traduccion: We have to recycle more to save the planet.

bloques.frase: In molte città italiane la raccolta ___ dei rifiuti è obbligatoria per legge.

opciones.explicacion: Official technical term: «raccolta differenziata» (selective waste collection).
It would mean «mezclada», contrary to the principle of recycling.
It would mean «abandonada», outside the municipal cleaning service.

bloques.pregunta: What is the correct form of the «We should recycle.» conditional?

opciones.explicacion: First plural person in conditional mode: «dovremmo».
It is in present time of indication: «We must.».
Succession of infinitive without conjugating.

bloques.pregunta: What does the Italian noun «rifiuti» mean?

opciones.explicacion: Formal term for urban or industrial waste.

opciones.texto: Rejections of job offers by mail.
opciones.explicacion: It combines ecological material sense with social rejection.

opciones.texto: Recetas culinarias tradicionales de la región.
opciones.explicacion: It has no relation to gastronomy.

intro: The ecological debate requires proposing collective measures, warning about pollution and suggesting sustainable solutions using **bisogna + infinito**, **dovremmo** (dovere conditional) and **è importante che + congiuntivo**.
